privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: How we collect, use, share, and keep information about you and the visitors to the websites you publish.
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy describes how {company} ("we," "us," or "our") collects, uses, and shares information about you when you use {service} and our related websites, applications, and services (collectively, the "Services") or when you otherwise interact with us.

collect.heading: Information We Collect
collect.intro: We collect information you provide directly to us, including:

items.0: Account details: your name, email address, and, if you sign in with Google, your profile image
items.1: Workspace and business details you enter, such as your business name, address, and the people you invite
items.2: Content you create or upload, including website, links page, and blog content, files, and messages you send to the assistant

collect.outro: You choose what content you add to the Services. Do not upload information you have no right to share.

collectAutomatically.heading: Information We Collect Automatically
collectAutomatically.intro: When you access or use our Services, we automatically collect certain information, including:

log.label: Log Information:
log.text: We collect information about your use of the Services, including the type of browser you use, access times, pages viewed, your IP address, and the page you visited before navigating to our Services.

device.label: Device Information:
device.text: We collect information about the computer or mobile device you use to access our Services, including the hardware model, operating system and version, unique device identifiers, and mobile network information.

location.label: Location Information:
location.text: We may derive your approximate location from your IP address.

use.heading: Use of Information
use.intro: We use the information we collect to:

items.0: Provide, maintain, and secure the Services
items.1: Send you sign-in codes, workspace invitations, and security notices
items.2: Operate AI features by sending your prompts and content to the AI providers listed below
items.4: Prevent abuse and enforce our Terms of Service

sharing.heading: Sharing of Information
sharing.intro: We may share information about you as follows or as otherwise described in this Privacy Policy:

items.0: With the service providers listed below
items.1: With people you invite to your workspace
items.2: With visitors, for content you choose to publish
items.3: In response to a request for information if we believe disclosure is in accordance with, or required by, any applicable law, regulation, or legal process
items.4: If we believe your actions are inconsistent with our user agreements or policies, or to protect the rights, property, and safety of us or others
items.5: In connection with, or during negotiations of, any merger, sale of company assets, financing, or acquisition of all or a portion of our business by another company
items.6: With your consent or at your direction

visitors.heading: Visitors to Websites You Publish
visitors.body: When you publish a website, you decide why and how the personal information of its visitors is processed, and we process it on your behalf. This includes contact form submissions (name, email address, phone number, and message) and website analytics. Website analytics use a random first-party visitor identifier, honor Do Not Track and Global Privacy Control, and do not store raw IP addresses or full user agents.

processors.heading: Service Providers
processors.intro: We rely on these service providers to run the Services. They process information on our behalf:

items.0: Vercel, for hosting, file storage, domains and DNS, performance measurement, and bot protection
items.1: Our managed database and cache hosting providers, for storing account, workspace, and content data
items.3: Google, for sign-in if you choose it and for business address lookups
items.4: AI model providers reached through Vercel AI Gateway, currently OpenAI, Google, Anthropic, and DeepSeek, plus AI quality-check services
items.5: PostHog, for product analytics and error reporting, and Tinybird, for analytics of published websites
items.6: Firecrawl, for web search, and Unsplash and Pexels, for stock photo search

retention.heading: Data Retention
retention.body: We keep raw website analytics events for 90 days and aggregated website analytics for 13 months. We keep other account and workspace data until you ask us to delete it. Workspace owners can delete a workspace from its settings, and you can ask us to delete your account by emailing the privacy address below. We may keep some records where the law requires it.

rights.heading: Your Rights and Choices
rights.body1: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal information. You may also have the right to restrict or object to certain processing of your information. To exercise these rights, email the privacy address shown under Contact Us.
rights.body2: You may opt out of receiving promotional communications from us by following the instructions in those messages. If you opt out, we may still send you non-promotional communications, such as those about your account or our ongoing business relations.

cookies.heading: Cookies and Similar Technologies
cookies.body: We use necessary cookies to keep you signed in and to remember your active workspace, your language and theme preferences, and the sign-in method you last used. We also use analytics: PostHog stores identifiers in cookies or local storage, and when you are signed in we associate that activity with your account ID, name, and email address; Vercel Speed Insights measures page performance. These run whenever you use the Services. You can clear or block cookies in your browser, but blocking necessary cookies stops sign-in from working.

security.heading: Security
security.body: We take reasonable measures to help protect information about you from loss, theft, misuse, and unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, and destruction. However, no internet or email transmission is ever fully secure or error-free.

children.heading: Children's Privacy
children.body: Our Services are not directed to children under 16, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 16. If we learn that we have collected personal information from a child under 16, we will take steps to delete such information.

international.heading: International Data Transfers
international.body: Our service providers may process information in the United States and other countries where they or their sub-processors operate.

changes.heading: Changes to This Policy
changes.body: We may change this Privacy Policy from time to time. If we make changes, we will notify you by revising the date at the top of the policy and, in some cases, we may provide you with additional notice (such as adding a statement to our homepage or sending you a notification).

contact.heading: Contact Us
contact.body: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or want to exercise your rights, contact us at

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.description: The terms that govern your use of the Services, including your content, AI features, custom domains, and acceptable use.
terms.intro: These Terms of Service (the "Terms") govern your access to and use of {service} and our related websites, applications, and services (the "Services"), which are operated by {company} ("we," "us," or "our"). By creating an account or using the Services, you agree to these Terms and to our Privacy Policy.

acceptance.heading: Acceptance of These Terms
acceptance.body: The Services are operated by {company}. By creating an account or using the Services, you agree to these Terms. If you use the Services on behalf of an organization, you confirm that you are authorized to bind that organization to these Terms. You must be at least 16 years old to use the Services.

service.heading: The Services
service.body: {service} is an AI-assisted website builder that includes websites, links pages, a blog, a customer inbox, custom domains, analytics, an AI assistant, and API and MCP access. We may add, change, or remove features over time. Some features rely on third-party providers, which are listed in our Privacy Policy.

accounts.heading: Your Account
accounts.body: You sign in without a password, using a one-time code sent to your email address or your Google account, so you must keep control of that email address or Google account. You are responsible for activity in your account and for any API keys and MCP connections you create. Workspace owners manage roles and invitations for their workspace. Tell us promptly if you believe someone has used your account without permission.

content.heading: Your Content
content.body: You own the content you add to the Services. You grant us a license to host, store, process, translate, display, and publish that content as needed to provide the Services and as you direct. You are responsible for having the rights to your content and for making sure it is lawful. Websites and links pages you publish are public on the internet. Review generated drafts before you publish them.

ai.heading: AI Features
ai.body: AI output can be inaccurate, incomplete, or similar to output generated for others, and it is not professional advice. Your prompts and content are processed by the AI providers listed in our Privacy Policy. Do not submit information you have no right to share.

domains.heading: Custom Domains
domains.body: Connect only domains you own or control. We verify ownership using DNS records we give you. You are responsible for your DNS settings, renewals, and your registrar's terms. Where domain registration is offered through our provider, it is subject to that provider's terms. We may disconnect a domain that fails verification or is used in breach of these Terms.

acceptableUse.heading: Acceptable Use
acceptableUse.body: You will not use the Services to publish or send content that is unlawful, infringing, deceptive, harassing, hateful, or sexually exploitative; to run phishing, spread malware, or impersonate others; or to send unsolicited bulk messages through contact forms. You will not probe, attack, or overload the Services, bypass limits or access controls, or abuse API or MCP access.

reporting.heading: Reporting and Enforcement
reporting.body: To report content or infringement, contact us using the details below and include the URL and a description of the problem. We may remove content, disable a website or links page, or suspend or terminate accounts that break these Terms or the law. We do not review all content in advance.

siteVisitors.heading: Your Website Visitors
siteVisitors.body: You are responsible for giving the visitors to your websites any notices and obtaining any consents they are owed, and for using contact form submissions and analytics from your websites lawfully. We process that data on your behalf as described in our Privacy Policy.

termination.heading: Ending Your Use
termination.body: You may stop using the Services at any time and can ask us to delete your account and workspace data by contacting us. We may suspend or end your access for violations of these Terms, for security reasons, or for legal reasons, and may then disable your published websites and links pages.

changes.heading: Changes to These Terms
changes.body: We may update these Terms and will show the new date at the top of this page. For material changes, we may also notify you in the product or by email. If you continue to use the Services after a change, you accept the updated Terms. We record the version in effect when your account is created.

contact.body: For legal notices, questions about these Terms, or reports of content that breaks them, contact us at

index.title: Website templates
index.description: Browse ready-made website templates for small businesses, each available in English and Arabic, then build your own site from a single sentence.
index.heading: Website templates
index.intro: Each template is a complete, bilingual home page with its own layout, colors, and type. Pick a starting point and make it yours.

airy-spacious.name: Airy Spacious
airy-spacious.title: Airy Spacious: a bright template for guides and tour operators
airy-spacious.description: A light, image-led website template for guides, tour operators, and outdoor studios, with a full-bleed hero, team grid, gallery, and quotes.
airy-spacious.summary: Airy Spacious opens on a full-bleed photo hero and lets imagery lead. A scroll-reveal manifesto, sticky-image feature list, staggered team grid, centered quote carousel, and editorial bento gallery suit businesses that sell an experience, finishing with a large contact section.

midnight-aurora.name: Midnight Aurora
midnight-aurora.title: Midnight Aurora: a template for advisors and professional firms
midnight-aurora.description: A polished website template for advisory and professional service firms, with a service carousel, plan comparison, team, reviews, and maps.
midnight-aurora.summary: Midnight Aurora pairs a bento-grid hero with a carousel of services, key figures, and a client logo grid. Plan cards, a ruled team grid, rated testimonials, FAQs, and two map layouts give advisory and professional firms room to explain what they offer and where to find them.

paw-voyage.name: Paw Voyage
paw-voyage.title: Paw Voyage: a friendly template for owner-run service businesses
paw-voyage.description: A warm website template for owner-run service businesses, with a step-by-step process, one clear price, a founder profile, and FAQs.
paw-voyage.summary: Paw Voyage is built for a business with one person behind it. A split photo hero leads into numbered how-it-works cards, a feature carousel, headline figures, a single pricing plan, and a founder profile, followed by a full-screen testimonial slider, an image FAQ, and contact links.
